notes.title: Version 1.3.2 Update Notes
notes.notes:
This minor update aims to optimize the RAM usage of this game, which resulted in a more noticeable change being that all of the sprites in the game now align with the pixel grid instead of the sub-pixel grid like it used to.

Changes:

The rendering method of this game has been massively tweaked to be rendering at a smaller scale, which results in a more "pixelated" or "pixel-perfect" look.
You can still turn on sub-pixel alignment to the background layers in (config) > (video) > (sub-px scroll). The game will be slightly less performant with this turned on.
The run button options have been moved from (accessibility) to (button mapping) in the (config) menu.

notes.title: v1.3.1 update notes
notes.notes:
The main purpose of this update is to do a debloat. Turns out there were libraries that weren't used in the game that was included in the build. They are now removed along with a few other unused files to free up storage space.

Along with that, this update also addresses the following issues:

New to v1.3, it was previously possible to die in the ceiling after defeating the final boss.
Jim sometimes makes way to much noise when you stomp on them.
The "End of another Venture" achievement was mistakenly given without completing the game.

notes.title: Update 1.3 - Refined enemy / object interactions
notes.notes:
This update adds miscellaneous polishes but mainly aims to refine some of the enemy behaviors to make them more intuitive and consistent. Beyond that, not much else is added.

Still no content update but if you want to play an ever so slightly different Froggo's Adventure, feel free to replay it.

Additions
You can now use the mouse cursor to navigate the menus.
Some of the menu options now have tiny icons representing them.
Changes
Collision engine has been tweaked so it's easier to fit into tight gaps or run across them.
Kicking is now slightly easier.
When rolling on an acorn / apple, you can now hit a block from above by simply jumping on it, instead of having to run across the top of it.
The "End of the Venture!" achievement can now be claimed by defeating the final boss again regardless if you had previously completed the game.
During the result screen of a level, tallying completion time has been accelerated.
Respawn mechanics has been tweaked, now enemies will only respawn if it's out of bounds or launched off-screen by the player. Ball objects like acorn or apple now also respawn.
Enemy changes
Blue Jim's look now matches their red counterpart. They also do short hops when idling to better reflect their behavior.
Red ant will now slide before kicking an object.
You can now snatch the acorn / apple from a Lbugg rolling on it.
Lbuggs will jump towards the acorn / apple when trying to hop on them.
Chain grabber objects from Berry Bridge can now be grappled onto.
The final boss waits slightly longer before attack and the blue projectiles from them has been made slower.Level design changes
Text box in the overworld has been updated with a bit more information.
More checkpoints were added to the first level.
The text box from Moody Fruity Woods is now also in Tall Tall Treetops.
Fixes
Ball objects like acorn / apple should now behave more consistently.
Some of the tiles from Tall Tall Treetops were misplaced to have the wrong collision type, which has now been corrected.
Objects were able to respawn in any sub area regardless of their original spawn location.
Grabbo Jaw doesn't bite when Froggo grab onto it.
There was a glitch involving the chain grabber that allows the player to launch themselves forward at a really high speed by simply jumping off the grabber right after the moment they were grabbed, which has finally been fixed.
Jim's rolling speed after being stomped on should now be consistent.
Leaving an underwater door should now lock it from being accessed until the player move away from it or press down.

notes.title: Update 1.2: Added Achievements!
notes.notes:
Additions:
Added 8 achievements to the game. Have fun hunting for them!
New 4:3 aspect ratio option in the video settings. (config > video > aspect ratio)

Changes:
Cutscenes can no longer be paused.
New animation for unlocking a level.
Urchins now have a smaller hit-box.
Various level design changes:
More health lilies are hidden across all levels.
First level has more changes.
Fixes
Animation for exiting a door while balancing on a ball is now fixed.

notes.title: Version 1.1.3 patch
notes.notes:
This patch should address the following issues:

Sometimes the stage doesn't reload when the player dies. (New to v1.1)
The default input mapping for "Controller (XBOX 360 For Windows)" is incorrectly set to the same as "Nintendo Switch Pro Controller" mapping.
A very bizarre glitch in the boss fight with Lily the witch that causes the projectiles from the player to occasionally miss her.

Changes

When standing on a moving platform that moves into the ceiling, you will no longer be squished and, instead, just drop down from the moving platform.

notes.title: Version 1.1 Update: Added Run button and more!
notes.notes:
Hello dear players, I've been receiving feedback about the inclusion of a run button ever since the release, and this update adds that and various other changes!

New features:

The Run button: hold it and Froggo will run.

You can configure it in [config] > [accessibility].
The first option in this tab, "run button", should allow you to choose between the following options:
[olist]
"none": No run button.
"a2": The same as using tongue. This is also the default one.
"a3": For people who want the run button to be separate than other action input.
"auto": Auto-run.
[/olist]
The second option, "double-tap run", should allow you to enable or disable double-tapping as a way to run.

You can now return to your last checkpoint by bringing up the pause menu and select "return to checkpoint".
You can now manually save the game by bringing up the pause menu and select "save game" in the overworld. (Note: if you have a save file with a glitched completion percentage (e.g. 97%, 102%...), hitting this should fix it)
Standing in front of a level door in the overworld will now show the level data, including the level name, the gems collected, and your best completion time.
You can now duck by pressing down. (it does nothing)

Changes:

Health points no longer max out at 3. (Though you still respawn with 3)
Dialogue tile can no longer be interacted by anything other than Froggo's tongue.
That single pillar in "witch's tower" is no longer bouncy.
The third digit of the version number is now displayed in the title screen.


I hope this update greatly improves the experience for everyone. If came across any issues with this new version, please let me now so I can help resolve them!

notes.title: Day 3 Patch (v1.0.9)
notes.notes:
This patch should address the following issues:
[olist]
In the fourth level (the water level), if you hit the item block with the trigger first and hit the checkpoint afterwards, respawning at that checkpoint would result in a soft lock due to the trigger no longer being available.
Some objects on screen "vibrates" ever so slightly by a sub-pixel when the camera is moving. This is due to the on screen coordinate being calculated using int() instead of round() like the tile map and every other objects.
Two tiles in the overworld has been assigned the wrong collision type.
[/olist]

notes.title: Day 2 Patch (v1.0.8)
notes.notes:
This patch should fix the following problems:

In full screen, the game stretches the window to your monitor's full size which distorts visuals.
Spamming the button on the "return to hub" option or after a level results screen skips all animation, including the level unlocking animation, preventing the new level to be unlocked.
In the second level, right after the second checkpoint, player can fall through the spinning platform while it turns around on the track.
Jim can still hit blocks after respawning in the walking state
Dance with an item in mouth causes the animation to glitch out.
After respawning on a checkpoint, previously collected coin blocks can still be hit.

notes.title: Tiny patch for a tiny game (v1.0.7)
notes.notes:
Changes:

Off screen barriers are now working properly so players don't get soft locked trying to go through them.
Minor changes to level 2 and 3.
